verdicts.title: No request timeout/abort in api.ts wedges the reconnect sync loop and stalls writes
verdicts.reason: Confirmed in source: withCredentials (lines 53-55) only spreads {credentials:'include', ...init} and never adds a signal; createWorkout/endWorkout (97-126) and by extension every other exported call in api.ts pass no AbortController/signal to fetcher(). There is no timeout, no AbortSignal.timeout(), and no early-return/guard in api.ts that would bound a hung fetch. The mechanism claimed (raw, unbounded fetch with no abort wiring) is real and reachable as written in this file.
